title: Live tool activity and safer task execution

features.title: See tools working in chat
features.description: Follow tool names, approval waits, outcomes and elapsed time inside each reply.

features.title: Follow longer tasks
features.description: Phone and PC progress and specialist work are grouped under the task that started them, with links to Tasks and STOP.

features.title: Keep activity with saved chats
features.description: Compact activity records survive reopening and restart. Interrupted calls stay unconfirmed until their outcomes are checked.

features.title: Faster, bounded execution
features.description: Independent reads can overlap, progressing tasks can earn limited extra rounds, and clear volume and timer commands avoid unnecessary model calls.

features.title: Updates inside JARVIS
features.description: Review release changes, download an update in the app and install through Android's confirmation screen.

fixes.title: Reject invalid and duplicate actions
fixes.description: Tool arguments are checked before execution, with saved operation identities protecting against duplicate effects.

fixes.title: Keep uncertain results honest
fixes.description: Native timeouts and unconfirmed Clock intents remain unverified. Read-only outcome checks never repeat an action.

fixes.title: Keep results in the correct conversation
fixes.description: Late results, nested activity and verified PC screenshots stay with the request that produced them.

fixes.title: Match tools to actual capabilities
fixes.description: Screenshot routing, permission checks and tool availability reflect the selected provider and installed Android capabilities.

fixes.title: Keep activity metadata private
fixes.description: Tool history excludes credentials, raw arguments, message bodies and image payloads, and stays separate from model conversation context.
